# Reactive programming — RxJS streams, observables and backpressure patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor — @aj-geddes's reactive programming skill: a practical RxJS playbook for async data flows. Covers when reactive fits (event-driven UIs, WebSocket/SSE, multi-source combining), a minimal working quick-start, and a clear do/don't list — unsubscribe to prevent leaks, use operators instead of nested subscriptions, handle errors, use shareReplay for expensive streams. Honest caveats: the detailed implementation guides (RxJS basics, debounced search, state management, WebSocket reconnection, custom operators, backpressure) live in the repo's `references/` directory and are fetched at install time — the skill file itself is the overview and index. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
